description: Published facts for one salon, NOT live availability and NOT an extras-inclusive quote. For a service/budget/extras/date decision use compare_options with salon=ref. For one salon (ref from search_merchants) and a date: published opening hours on that date (open/closed — NOT live appointment slots), offerings matching the service with published prices and durations, the booking link and step-by-step booking instructions. Profiled salons add candidate start times (candidate start times from the salon's published staff schedule; existing bookings are not subtracted, so some may already be taken — confirm on the booking page). Same contract as GET /api/v1/availability?ref=.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default today in the city’s timezone)
